Press Alt+B to open the Community Board. Its menu on the left holds most of what this land offers beyond the shops: Adventurer's Guide - the Guidebook. Passive Tree - your passive skill points. Buff Templates - cast your saved buffs in one click. Crafting Goals - track the materials of an item you want to craft. Session Log - what you achieved since you logged in. Gatekeeper - teleports, from inside a town. Bounties and Requests - today's quests of the nearest Notice Board. Bestiary - the monsters you met and what they drop. Night - tonight's Omen and the creatures of the night. PvP Ranking - the fiercest fighters of the land.

The Home and Gatekeeper pages can only be used inside a town.
